shared_elements: rounded sculpted head-like volume rendered in the round
panels of fine parallel incised lines
cross-hatched / lattice grid of incised lines (hair or headdress-like treatment)
shallow schematic incision over a three-dimensional form
justification: Both show a rounded three-dimensional carved mass whose surface bears panels of fine parallel and cross-hatched incised lines, closely comparable to the striated hair/headdress framing the head in A, so the incision convention and the treated zone plausibly correspond. The decisive difference is that A depicts a whole schematic anthropomorphic figure with face, arms, necklace with a central disc, belt and chevron motifs, while B preserves only the hatched dome with no face, disc or other identifiable iconography, so the specific combinations and relationships cannot be matched.
